description: Static provider registry for the Mimir frontend. Live status must later come from api.mmir.ai / mimir-backend-template, not raw provider runtimes.

providers.label: GitHub Fallback
providers.notes: Planned lightweight mock/fallback provider for demos, tests and resilience when hosted LLMs are unavailable.

providers.label: OCI / Ollama
providers.notes: Provisioning track is prepared, but OCI Ampere A1 capacity may block compute launch.

providers.label: AWS Backend
providers.notes: Alternative provider track for Mimir-compatible backend capacity.

providers.label: Local Ollama
providers.route: local browser test or controlled connector when promoted
providers.notes: Useful for free local experiments. Raw Ollama 11434 must not be exposed publicly.

providers.label: Custom Backend
providers.route: api.mmir.ai or trusted custom connector URL
providers.notes: For users who bring their own compatible backend. Secrets stay server-side.

providers.label: Edge / Jetson
providers.role: Future edge and robotics node provider
providers.notes: Future track for Jetson, ED-209/ED-309 and local device nodes.
